blocks.text: CALAPAN CITY, ORIENTAL MINDORO, Philippines — The local government of Abra de Ilog in Occidental Mindoro is drawing up a sustainable ecotourism management plan for Luyang Baga Cave to ensure its future development protects the natural site while promoting community participation. The municipality conducted a three-day planning workshop from Oct. 27 to 29 in Sablayan, Occidental Mindoro, bringing together local government officials, barangay leaders and representatives of nearby Iraya Mangyan communities. Mayor Maria Gloria Constantino joined representatives from various municipal offices, including the Municipal Planning and Development Office, Municipal Environment and Natural Resources Office, Disaster Risk Reduction and Management Office, Engineering […]...
